title: Bar Salts Cherry Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid By Vampire Vape
description: Experience the mouth-watering rush of Cherry Ice from Vampire Vape's Bar Salts collection, an e-liquid that elegantly pairs the natural sweetness of ripe cherries with a frigid, exhilarating icy breeze. On the inhale, the tartness of fresh, plump cherries envelops your tastebuds, as though handpicked at the peak of summer. But that's just the opening act. This exquisite flavour profile subtly evolves, introducing an icy chill that perfectly complements the intense cherry sweetness. The result is an endlessly layered and invigorating vaping journey that tilts deliciously between warm and juicy, fruity and frosty. If you’ve adored similar flavours found in disposable vapes, then you’ll absolutely swoon for Cherry Ice from Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts collection of 10ml Nic Salt e-liquids with non-disposable vapes. This premium e-liquid boasts a 50VG/50PG ratio, expertly balancing flavour and vapour. Perfect for starter kits and pod systems, its nicotine salt formulation offers a smooth, gratifying throat hit—especially ideal for those fresh off cigarettes. Nicotine Salt E-liquids are absorbed swiftly, making them a great choice for immediate relief from nicotine cravings. Moreover, these 10ml bottles serve as a more sustainable alternative to disposables, letting you enjoy the same satisfaction with less waste. Looking for something a bit different? Check out the Bar Salts collection by Vampire Vape, featuring many other exciting flavours like Blue Sour Raspberry, Mango and Pineapple Ice. These 10ml e-liquids can be used in starter kits and pod kits and they allow you to enjoy your favourite flavours for far longer than a 2ml disposable vape device, all while reducing plastic waste. And because they share the same nicotine salt formulation as their disposable cousins, Vampire Vape Bar Salts deliver all the satisfying relief from nicotine cravings along with a super-smooth throat hit for comfortable, effective and enjoyable all-day vaping.
